name: Question 1
problem:
Given the joint probability distribution for two discrete random variables $X$ and $Y$ below, find $\text{E}[5X-2Y].$

| $f$ | $Y=0$ | $Y=1$ | $Y=2$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $X=0$ | $0.05$ | $0.1$ | $0.25$ |
| $X=1$ | $0.25$ | $0.15$ | $0.2$ |
worked_solution:
Recall that the marginal distribution for $X$ corresponds to the row totals, and the marginal distribution for $Y$ corresponds to the column totals. | $f$ | $Y=0$ | $Y=1$ | $Y=2$ | ${f}_{X}$ | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | $X=0$ | $0.05$ | $0.1$ | $0.25$ | $0.4$ | | $X=1$ | $0.25$ | $0.15$ | $0.2$ | $0.6$ | | ${f}_{Y}$ | $0.3$ | $0.25$ | $0.45$ | $1$ | Therefore, the probability mass functions for $X$ and $Y$ are given by the following tables:
$x$ $0$ $1$
${f}_{X}(x)$ $0.4$ $0.6$

$y$ $0$ $1$ $2$
${f}_{Y}(y)$ $0.3$ $0.25$ $0.45$

Now, we can compute the expected values for $X$ and $Y:$ $$ \begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i}\,{f}_{X}({x}_{i}) \\ & =0\cdot 0.4+1\cdot 0.6 \\ & =0+0.6 \\ & =0.6\end{aligned} $$ $$ \begin{aligned}\text{E}[Y] & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{y}_{i}\,{f}_{Y}({y}_{i}) \\ & =0\cdot 0.3+1\cdot 0.25+2\cdot 0.45 \\ & =0+0.25+0.9 \\ & =1.15.\end{aligned} $$ Finally, using the properties of expectation, we obtain $$ \begin{aligned}\text{E}[5X-2Y] & =5\,\text{E}[X]-2\,\text{E}[Y] \\ & =5(0.6)-2(1.15) \\ & =3-2.3 \\ & =0.7.\end{aligned} $$

Given the joint probability distribution for two discrete random variables X and Y below, find E[5X−2Y].

f Y=0 Y=1 Y=2
X=0 0.05 0.1 0.25
X=1 0.25 0.15 0.2
a
1.7
b
1.5

Incorrect
EXPLANATION

Recall that the marginal distribution for X corresponds to the row totals, and the marginal distribution for Y corresponds to the column totals.

f Y=0 Y=1 Y=2 fX
X=0 0.05 0.1 0.25 0.4
X=1 0.25 0.15 0.2 0.6
fY 0.3 0.25 0.45 1

Therefore, the probability mass functions for X and Y are given by the following tables:

x 0 1
fX(x) 0.4 0.6

y 0 1 2
fY(y) 0.3 0.25 0.45

Now, we can compute the expected values for X and Y:

E[X]=∑i=1nxifX(xi)=0⋅0.4+1⋅0.6=0+0.6=0.6

E[Y]=∑i=1nyifY(yi)=0⋅0.3+1⋅0.25+2⋅0.45=0+0.25+0.9=1.15.

Finally, using the properties of expectation, we obtain

E[5X−2Y]=5E[X]−2E[Y]=5(0.6)−2(1.15)=3−2.3=0.7.
